subject: Re: Request: Overrun amnesty & staged credits for launch week
messages:
From: Ellen Park <finance@clearport.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Overrun amnesty & staged credits for launch week

Hi Irene —

Quick note from ClearPort’s finance team: our new consumer-facing feature launched last week and generated a burst we didn’t fully anticipate. We’re currently ~2.8x over our committed QPS for the week (see attached usage CSV). Our procurement lead asked whether Redwood can provide temporary overrun amnesty for the launch window and a short-term staged credit to help smooth cashflow while we finalize a higher-commitment PO.

High-level ask:
- 14-day amnesty for the overrun (no immediate invoice for the burst)
- A staged credit covering 50% of the incremental overage for that period
- We’ll commit to a PO for a higher reserved tier by end of month if we see sustained traffic

Appreciate any flexibility — this is a strategic customer for us and we want to avoid disruption. Attaching usage export and a one-page summary.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Finance Manager
ClearPort Systems
[attachment: ClearPort_usage_report_May2028.csv (csv)]

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Overrun amnesty & staged credits for launch week

Team — forwarding ClearPort’s ask from finance. Key points: 14-day amnesty, 50% credit on incremental overage, commit to PO by 30 Jun if usage stabilizes.

Questions for proposal:
- Can we offer a two-week temporary amnesty without creating adverse billing precedents?
- What’s the simplest credit instrument (invoice credit vs one-off rebate) to give procurement confidence but preserve accounting cleanliness?
- If we require a short-term purchase order as condition, what minimum commit do we need to protect our unit economics?

I’ve attached the usage export. Ben — can you draft an initial terms note we can send to Ellen (include a short commitment path / milestone schedule)? Karthik — please flag any sanctions/contract clauses we should surface. Grace — please prep the HubSpot deal update and link the doc.

Thanks — Irene
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[attachment: ClearPort_usage_report_May2028.csv (csv)]

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: Overrun amnesty & staged credits for launch week

Irene / team — draft terms below we can offer as a one-time exception tied to a PO cadence. I kept language tight for procurement to review quickly.

Proposed one-time amnesty + staged credit (v1):
- Amnesty period: 14 calendar days covering 2028-06-03 through 2028-06-16
- Amnesty mechanics: No invoice will be issued for usage above contracted QPS during the amnesty window; usage will still be logged for audit
- Staged credit: Redwood will apply a credit equal to 50% of the incremental overage for the amnesty period, applied against the next invoice after the amnesty window
- Condition: ClearPort issues a non-binding PO for a +35% reserved capacity increase to begin 2028-07-01, to be followed by a formal contract amendment by 2028-06-30. If PO is not issued, credits convert to a 30% discount on the first invoice post-amnesty
- Limit: Amnesty & credit cap at $75,000 USD incremental usage (to protect exposure)
- Accounting: Invoice credit entry, with a one-line addendum to the master SOW (DocuSign link to follow)

Attached: proposed_amnesty_terms_v1.pdf (for internal review).

Karthik — flagged two legal items: (1) we should add a carve-out preventing repeated requests in a 12-month window; (2) define audit window for usage validation. If either are problematic, we can adjust the cap and PO requirement.

Irene — happy to send this to Ellen with minimal edits. Grace — please add the HubSpot deal note: CP-4782 and attach the usage CSV + terms PDF.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed_amnesty_terms_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ellen Park <finance@clearport.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearport.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Overrun amnesty & staged credits for launch week

Irene / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear terms. Procurement reviewed and is comfortable with the PO-conditioned path. We’ll:

- Issue a non-binding PO by 2028-06-20 for the +35% reserved capacity increase (covers our initial scale target)
- Sign the DocuSign addendum acknowledging the amnesty mechanics and credit cap

A couple small asks from procurement: can the DocuSign addendum include the audit window (30 days post-amnesty) and the 12-month repeat exception you mentioned? Also, please copy our procurement alias on the DocuSign envelope so they can countersign.

If you can send the final addendum I’ll have it routed for signatures today. Appreciate the flexibility — this keeps our launch on track and avoids an invoice dispute.

Best,
Ellen Park
Finance Manager
ClearPort Systems
